verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken structure: the RSVP CTA is shrunk into a pill no bigger than the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS badges, so the action is buried. '6 pm, Harbour Rooftop' is jammed against the end of the headline as tiny orphaned text, the tagline and 'Reserve a spot' copy float in scattered fragments on the left, and the legal text and red placeholder stub are illegibly small. A additionally runs its legal block over the decorative circle and packs 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' inside it. B moves the legal text clear of the circle, so it is marginally cleaner.
